note: Each amendment was recorded before the amended query was executed. The pre-search sensitivity check below is the evidence that motivated them.

pre_search_sensitivity_check.method: Known relevant works were resolved to PubMed PMIDs, then tested for membership in the full result set of each planned query.

results.known_item: PDSQI-9 validation, J Am Med Inform Assoc 2025, doi 10.1093/jamia/ocaf068, PMID 40323321
LLM summarisation of mental health counseling sessions, JMIR Ment Health 2024, PMID 39042893

pre_search_sensitivity_check.diagnosis: The planned transfer query requires 'clinical note*' OR 'medical summar*' OR 'clinical documentation' in Title/Abstract. The PDSQI-9 validation paper describes 'provider documentation summarization' for 'large language models' and matches none of them. No planned query contains any term for automatic or model-based note generation, which is the subject matter of the benchmark under development.

amendments.reason: The planned query set contains no term for large language models, AI scribes or automatic note generation. The literature on model-generated clinical documentation and its evaluation was therefore unreachable, including the PDSQI-9 validation paper that the protocol names as a retrieval seed.

amendments.type: added query, compensating for an unavailable database
amendments.reason: APA PsycINFO is not accessible from this environment (EBSCOhost requires an institutional login). PsycINFO was the only database planned for the requirements layer, so without an amendment that layer would have no executed search at all. A PubMed requirements query recovers part, not all, of the intended coverage. PsycINFO remains a declared gap; this amendment does not close it.

Client reading of their own record, supervision needs and privacy were named as under-covered in the previous formative round and are among the four declared purposes, but no planned query targets them directly.

Documentation quality instruments are the most directly transferable evidence for item wording and rating format, and the planned queries reach them only incidentally. A dedicated instrument query makes that evidence reachable and its recall auditable.

ACL Anthology has no query API. The complete Anthology BibTeX corpus is downloaded and searched offline with recorded regular expressions, which is more reproducible than a web search box. The searched corpus snapshot is checksummed.

amendments.type: declared deviation, not a query change
amendments.reason: JBI conduct guidance requires a minimum of two reviewers for study selection and at least two for extraction. This round has one investigator and an AI assistant. Screening and extraction here are AI proposals awaiting human decision; they are not dual independent review and are not reported as completed screening.

amendments.type: a database recorded as unsearched was searched, by a different route
amendments.recorded_before_use: the queries were, this record was not. The three query strings were fixed in a handover note at 11:35 and the first export was downloaded at 11:43 the same day; this amendment was written after the exports arrived.
amendments.reason: Scopus was one of two databases the 2026-09-13 round declared as a gap, because api.elsevier.com returns HTTP 401 without a key, and the assistant has no key. The gap mattered: Scopus indexes journals outside MEDLINE, including the German-language psychotherapy literature, so the direct layer of this review was searched in one biomedical database and one NLP corpus only. The investigator has institutional access to the web interface, which needs no key, and ran the three queries there by hand.
amendments.route: web interface, executed by the investigator; not re-runnable from this repository. The query strings, the date, the export files and their checksums are in search-log-scopus.json.
amendments.what_it_does_not_close: the queries cover the three subjects of the parent protocol and nothing else, the interface's reported hit counts were not captured, so completeness of each export is unverified, and screening of what it returned is a separate record. APA PsycINFO remains unsearched.

amendments.type: a fourth layer is added to the search, because a question was asked that no existing query could answer
amendments.recorded_before_use: yes, and verifiably: this amendment and the seven query strings are committed before acl_search.py is given the new queries, so the commit that records them precedes the commit that can run them. AM-7 could not make this claim and said so.
amendments.reason: The first-generation Czech scorer measures six properties of a Czech note: a missing or wrong diacritic, a calque, an untranslated English term, a broken agreement or case, the wrong register, and a word that does not exist. Three of them sit inside K30 as a bundle and three have no candidate at all, and none has a source. The catalog recorded that as a lack of support, which was wrong: all twelve queries of the three existing layers are about psychotherapy notes, clinical documentation and its requirements, and acl-transfer requires the token summari[sz] to be present, so a paper on the typology of language errors could not have matched any of them. An unsearched layer reported as an absence of evidence is the same error as a missing answer counted as a zero.
what_changes: a fourth layer, `language`, with seven queries on the ACL Anthology corpus
the priority threshold does not change and stays at 9 points, because it is registered
the inclusion criterion does not change: does the work offer a property of a text, a rule for recognising it, or a way of measuring it
amendments.what_does_not_change: Nothing about the pool as it stands. The existing records of the pool, its priority stratum and the candidate pool are untouched; this layer adds to them and the counts are reported separately so the two rounds can be told apart.
amendments.databases: The ACL Anthology only, searched offline from the checksummed corpus of 2026-09-13. PubMed is not searched for this layer: translation-quality and error-typology work is not indexed there. Scopus would add conference proceedings outside the Anthology and is a declared gap for this layer rather than a silent one.
amendments.accepted_in_advance: Three outcomes are possible and all are reportable. The literature supports the criteria, and they become candidates with citations. It does not, and they stay unsupported next to K06, which is worse for the paper and honest. Or it offers properties nobody here had thought of, and the pool grows again, which is why this runs before the panel.
amendments.decision_pending: Whether criteria the literature does not support enter the pool anyway is the investigator's decision and he has reserved it until the result is in (2026-10-13: rozhodnu az podle vysledku reserse). Nothing here decides it, and the search writing a criterion into the catalog on its own would be deciding it by silence.

unavailable_sources.evidence: search.ebscohost.com redirects to an institutional login; no EBSCO credential is configured
